defaults.rationale: Only SUMO native road testing, not the NOA baseline or published behavior.

parameters.name: gui_shape
parameters.rationale: Rendering category only; no brand inference.

parameters.name: collision_action
parameters.rationale: Retain diagnostics; any reported collision fails the smoke gate.

parameters.name: demand_dt_s
parameters.rationale: Bernoulli trial interval of the reference mechanism; exact q converted to probability.

parameters.name: demand_duration_s
parameters.rationale: New finite cohort horizon; source ran to 600 s but original warmup/drain protocol not established.

parameters.name: smoke_demand_duration_s
parameters.rationale: Only q=1250 first 60 s are simulated in smoke; other files are generated and checked only.

parameters.name: smoke_end_s
parameters.rationale: Maximum drain timeout; residual vehicles cause failure, not silent dropping.

parameters.name: hidden_noa_fraction
parameters.rationale: Offline type labels for demand initialization, not neighbor observations; smoke vType is native_probe for every vehicle.

parameters.name: departure_speed_mps
parameters.rationale: Constant attempted entry speed chosen equal to paper desired speed; paper does not specify the random insertion details.

parameters.name: departure_position_m
parameters.rationale: SUMO front bumper position, so a 4 m car starts fully inside x>=0.

parameters.name: lanechange_duration_s
parameters.rationale: Native continuous lane-change test option, not proof of steering/yaw dynamics.

parameters.name: emergency_decel_mps2
parameters.rationale: Never adopt source emergencyDecel=30 as a new physical capability.

parameters.name: tau_s
parameters.rationale: Native IDM desired time headway; not a sensor latency or a validated NOA safety parameter.

parameters.name: idm_delta
parameters.rationale: IDM acceleration exponent, not steering angle.

parameters.name: lc_strategic
parameters.rationale: Allow native mandatory merging in road test.

parameters.name: probe_position_m
parameters.rationale: Separate termination-lane topology probe; excluded from unified entrance demand counts.

parameters.name: probe_speed_mps
parameters.rationale: Deliberate low-speed topology probe only; not 2022 paper desired speed migration.

parameters.name: max_lateral_step_m
parameters.rationale: Smoke synchronization discontinuity detector at 0.1 s; not a physical steering test.

parameters.name: max_depart_delay_s
parameters.rationale: SUMO unlimited insertion wait; all pending and uncompleted vehicles remain accounted for.

parameters.name: time_to_teleport_s
parameters.rationale: Disable automatic jam teleport; report timeout/failure.
